messages:
maya: Heads-up — design review for prompt-sets / evals results layout. I pushed a Figma update with two options: stacked cards (single-column dense list) vs grouped grid (masonry-like). Main concerns: keyboard scanability, a11y, and approval flow density. Thoughts?

liam: Looked through frames. Stacked cards win for keyboard nav and linear reading order. Grid breaks tab order and feels unpredictable for screenreaders. +1 stacked.

arya: Stacked is fine but it increases vertical scroll for large runs. Can we collapse metadata by default (model, seed, timestamps) and surface only key metrics? Expand on demand.

phil: Collapse sounds good. Propose a compact header with pass/fail counts + chevron to expand details. Keyboard notes: chevron must have aria-expanded and be toggleable via Enter/Space.

eva: Color contrast note — current pass green (#28a745) in the figma fails AA at 12px. Suggest darken to #1f7a32 or add a bold label. Also add an icon to badges (check/x) for colorblind folks.

maya: Good catches. Also product requirement: bulk-approve (batch) must preserve provenance — show who approved which prompt-set and include inline comment history in the confirmation.

liam: UX flow idea: selection mode with checkboxes, then a confirm modal that lists selected items and shows small provenance rows (approver, time, note). Modal needs an input for "auto-approve confidence threshold" and a "notify owners" toggle. Keyboard: modal focus order must be first interactive element.

arya: Tiny perf/a11y nit: regression diff token-highlights currently insert in-flow tags causing layout shift when diffs render. Suggest overlay highlights instead of reflow. Quick CSS idea:

```
.token-highlight { background: rgba(255,230,0,0.45); position: relative; pointer-events: none; }
```

phil: If we overlay highlights, ensure there's a high-contrast focus outline for keyboard users. Also make each diff token focusable (span[tabindex=0]) so screenreaders can read context and state (added/removed). :point_up:

eva: Add an aria-live polite region on the diff container to announce when diffs finish loading so SR users know content changed.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the Figma frames with: stacked cards + collapsed metadata + overlay token highlights + bulk-approve modal with provenance. Quick decision: react with :thumbsup: to move forward, :speech_balloon: to discuss more.

jordan: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

arya: :speech_balloon: can we prototype collapsing animations? concern about motion prefs — prefer respects prefers-reduced-motion.

maya: Good call. We'll add reduced-motion variants and note it in the handoff. I'll post updated frames by EOD and tag @design for final review.
